output_list.criticism: The function enter() is public, anyone can enter the room, regardless of the room's status. It should only be callable by the contract owner. This could be exploited to enter the room and take all the winnings.

The function enterWithReferral() is public, anyone can enter the room and receive referral cut, regardless of the room's status. It should only be callable by the contract owner. This could be exploited to enter the room, receive referral cut and take all the winnings.
